instruct:
You are an expert in HDFS log anomaly detection. Your task is to LOCALIZE the most anomaly-indicative lines inside the given log sequence.

Return STRICT JSON only (no extra text, no markdown).
Preferred compact schema: {"top_idx": [<int>, ...]}
- idx refers to the 1-based line number in the provided numbered list.
- Pick exactly N indices (N is given).

Optional backward-compatible schema (allowed but try to avoid): {"top_lines": [{"idx": <int>, "text": <string>, "score": <float>, "reason": <string>}]}
If you output top_lines, text MUST be an exact substring of the original line (do not paraphrase).

Higher score means stronger anomaly signal.
